==Background==
{{Quote|We ain't dying; neither of us are. Thank you!!|Author's comment}}
"'''ROKI'''" is an original song by Mikito-P.

This song has entered ''[[Hall of Myths]]'' on February 3, 2024, and exceeded over 86 million views on YouTube and over 3 million views on bilibili. Hence, this is one of Mikito-P's most notable songs.

==Other media appearances==
===Discography===
This song was featured in the following albums:
* [[DAISAN WAVE]]
* ロキ (Roki) (single)
* ロキ (Roki) (vinyl)

This song was featured in the following compilation albums:
* 初音ミク Project DIVA MEGA39’s 10th アニバーサリーコレクション (Hatsune Miku Project DIVA MEGA39's 10th Anniversary Collection) (Rin & Len's Version)
* [[EXIT TUNES PRESENTS Vocalodelight feat. 初音ミク]] (Rin & Len's Version)
* Leo/need SEKAI ALBUM Vol. 1 (SEKAI version by Leo/need and Hatsune Miku)

===Concerts===
This song was featured in the following concerts with [[Kagamine Len]]'s V4X vocals in-place of Mikito-P:
{{col-2b|
* [[Hatsune Miku × Kodo Taiko Special Live 2018|Hatsune Miku × Kodo 2018]]

* [[HATSUNE MIKU EXPO 2025 ASIA|MIKU EXPO 2025 ASIA]] (Setlist B)
*[[HATSUNE MIKU EXPO 2026 North America|MIKU EXPO 2026 North America]] (Setlist C)}}

===Literature===
This song was adapted into the book ''ROKI: THE CURSED SONG'', published by MF Bunko. The book is written by Souya Mukai, with MikitoP credited as the creator and Rocoru (under the name GAS) credited with the book's illustrations. It was originally released on September 22, 2022.
